name: Agent Skills Hub
summary: Security-graded directory of open-source agent skills and MCP servers at agentskillshub.top, operated by BRICKAI / GoSailGlobal LLC. Freemium; MIT; not the .dev site.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (a public GitHub pull request proposed the directory; counts, prices, and rules below come from official pages fetched 2026-11-23, not from the PR). Agent Skills Hub (AgentSkillsHub) is the directory at https://agentskillshub.top/, operated by BRICKAI / GoSailGlobal LLC and founded by Jason Zhu (official launch date 2026-03-08). Official ai-info and llms.txt state it is not affiliated with similarly named domains including agentskillshub.dev (that distinct site also returned HTTP 200 and is not this listing). As of this fetch, official llms.txt and https://agentskillshub.top/ai-info/ say the catalog indexes 282,000+ open-source AI agent skills, MCP servers, and tools from GitHub (refreshed every 8 hours) and security-grades 143,000+ repositories against 44 published rules (covering 99% of skills over 100 stars and 99% over 1,000). Those live figures supersede older PR text that said 276k / 138k / 43 rules. The Zenodo security-census snapshot at https://zenodo.org/records/21292799 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21292799; do not cite the doi.org redirect) is CC BY 4.0; official pages also mention 130,173 graded items in that deposit, which can lag the live catalog. https://github.com/zhuyansen/agent-skills-hub is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Jason Zhu), not archived, created 2026-03-06 and pushed 2026-11-23T05:57:58Z (2026-11-23 06:57:58 Europe/Stockholm). Pricing should be read from https://agentskillshub.top/enterprise/ (HTTP 200): Free is $0 forever, no card (catalog, quality score, basic scan, scenario pages). Pro is $29/year as an early-supporter price (standard $49/year) with deep README search, CSV/JSON export, and a CLI and MCP API key. Team CI Gate is $49/month (3–20 engineers) and mentions 43 SlowMist-aligned security checks — that plan wording differs from the 44 published rules on /how-we-grade/ and /ai-info/. Enterprise is listed at $10K–$30K/year per department (starter $10K, standard $20K, business $30K; 200+ engineers or regulated industries start at $50K/year). The same /ai-info/ page still says paid plans from $39/year (Pro Deep Search), Fast-Track Security Audit $49 per skill, and Team CI Skill Gate $29/month — those figures conflict with the /enterprise/ table and are recorded rather than silently preferred. This entry treats /enterprise/ as the pricing page and flags the mismatch. Documented `npx -y @agentskillshub/mcp` and CLI installs were not executed. Grading is a published rule-based method, not a substitute for your own review before installing a skill. No signup or spend.

agent_access.notes: The public catalog, analyzer, llms.txt, and /ai-info/ need no login. Official pages also document a local MCP as `npx -y @agentskillshub/mcp` (tools search_skills, audit_skill, get_skill_install) and a CLI; those packages were not installed or run. Paid Pro/Team plans add a CLI and MCP API key according to /enterprise/. No hosted streamable-HTTP MCP URL was used as mcp_endpoint. No account was created.
